messages.每个哨子按满活力的 3 小时帮忙产量计算，计入队伍帮手奖励。露营券和活动的生产加: Each whistle yields three hours of helping at full energy and includes Helping Bonus. Good Camp, event production bonuses and Main Skills are excluded. The 2.4× EX favorite berry bonus applies.

messages.每天按 100 分，在所选岛屿和睡眠类型范围内寻找最佳方案。开启拆分睡眠后，两觉: Search for the best option across the selected areas and sleep types at 100 points per day. With split sleep, both sessions use the same Snorlax Strength and share the 100 points.
messages.每日第11只起糖果为1，研究EXP与梦之碎片减半；实际遇到特殊UP时从第12只起: From the 11th encounter each day, Candy drops to 1 and research EXP and Dream Shards are halved. When a special boosted Pokémon appears, reduced rewards start from the 12th encounter. Rewards follow draw order. Extra encounters count toward the threshold; their rewards are excluded.
messages.每次方案平均糖果（同一进化链合并）: Average Candy per run (combined by evolution family)
messages.每觉最多搜索 50 亿睡意之力。计算次数用于每个候选抽取状态；精度控制能量候选点: Each session searches up to 5 billion Drowsy Power. Runs apply to each candidate draw state, and accuracy controls Strength and score split resolution.

messages.满 7 天后可在达标当天领回；有每日额外产糖时，按寄放天数间隔领回喂糖。未满 7: After seven days, pick up the Pokémon on the day it reaches the target. If it earns extra Candy daily, pick it up at the chosen interval to feed Candy. Picking it up before seven days halves Nap Island EXP.
messages.点一次单独模拟 4000 次当前方案。再点会换一批结果，不会和上一次加在一起。: Run 4,000 independent simulations for the current settings. Each run replaces the previous results.
messages.点击色块打开调色板，选好后应用。请保持文字与背景清晰可辨。: Select a swatch to open the palette, then apply your colors. Keep text and backgrounds easy to distinguish.
